name: to-human
description: The report view of a session under the to-human output style: assistant messages fold to their <message> spans, and tool calls, unmarked text and deliveries from agents and other sessions fold behind [ working record ] buttons; the message tool (mcp__to-human__message) sends a message before another tool call word for word, drawn where the call sits; each message the model sends raises a native notification through the person's own channel, which their Notification hooks read as plugin_notification
